title: IonQ Advances Quantum-Assured Navigation and Timing with DARPA Airborne Gravimeter Award and 51-Day Maritime Clock Trial
summary: IonQ's Vector Atomic subsidiary has made significant strides in quantum sensing for navigation and timing. They received a DARPA award to develop an airborne quantum gravimeter and successfully completed a 51-day maritime trial of their Evergreen-30 optical atomic clock for GPS-denied environments. These advancements aim to provide resilient position, navigation, and timing capabilities for defense platforms. title: IDEMIA Secure Transactions and IonQ Validate QKD Interoperability with IDEMIA Sphere Cybersecurity Platform
summary: IDEMIA Secure Transactions (IST) and IonQ have successfully validated the interoperability of IonQ's Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) systems with IST's IDEMIA Sphere cybersecurity portfolio. This integration allows quantum-generated cryptographic keys to be managed within existing enterprise security controls and compliance workflows, alongside Hardware Security Modules (HSMs) and Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC). title: Harvard, QuEra, NVIDIA, Anthropic, and Three National Labs Secure $12 Million DOE Award for AI-Driven Quantum Error Correction
summary: A consortium including Harvard, QuEra, NVIDIA, Anthropic, and three National Labs has received a $12 million DOE award for the ASQC initiative. This project will focus on developing AI-designed quantum error correction specifically tailored for scientific computing workloads. The goal is to reduce the overhead for fault tolerance by matching error-correcting codes, decoders, and compilers to specific scientific applications.
